name: Houndstooth
description: The broken check, tooth by tooth — a stepped tile that mirrors on the checker so the points interlock.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(0 0, 50% 0, 50% 25%, 75% 25%, 75% 50%, 100% 50%, 100% 100%, 50% 100%, 50% 75%, 25% 75%, 25% 50%, 0 50%); clip-path: polygon(0 0, 50% 0, 50% 25%, 75% 25%, 75% 50%, 100% 50%, 100% 100%, 50% 100%, 50% 75%, 25% 75%, 25% 50%, 0 50%); @even { -webkit-transform: scaleX(-1); transform: scaleX(-1); } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
